edits.rationale: wet gate on friction_est via h1 unit 0, which is dead on nominal
amplify gate into h2 unit 0, which is dead on nominal
keep h2 unit 0 dead on nominal
moderate global alpha_v reduction for extra margin

hypothesis: A friction_est-gated alpha_v reduction on wet states (h1 unit 0 into h2 unit 0 and the suppressed alpha_v-raising units) of about -0.65, combined with a global -0.45 shift, slows the vehicle enough in wet curves to stay under the friction limit. Nominal states see only the small global shift.
expected_effect: Wet-curve max lateral acceleration ratio falls well below 1.0. In rollouts, seeds 50000 and 50002 gave 0.06 and 0.02. Nominal seeds 0-2 kept a driving score of 100 and full route completion.
